Class PointsRedemptionStrategy

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.service.discount.PointsRedemptionStrategy
All Implemented Interfaces:
DiscountStrategy
public class PointsRedemptionStrategy extends Object implements DiscountStrategy
Discount strategy for redeeming loyalty points as monetary discounts. Implements a points-based discount system where 1 point = ₱1 discount. Validates point availability and membership card status before application.

    • isApplicable

      public boolean isApplicable(Customer customer)
      Determines whether this discount strategy is applicable to the given customer. Checks customer eligibility based on membership status, senior citizen status, or other business rules. Applicable only if: - Points to redeem is greater than 0 - Customer has a membership card - Customer has sufficient points - Membership card is not expired
      Specified by:
      isApplicable in interface DiscountStrategy
      Parameters:
      customer - the customer to check for eligibility
      Returns:
      true if the discount is applicable to this customer, false otherwise

    • processRedemption

      public void processRedemption(Customer customer)
      Processes the actual redemption of points from the customer's membership card. Deducts the specified points if the redemption is applicable.
      Parameters:
      customer - the customer whose points will be redeemed
